findings.summary: The order check now runs after the field_transformer hook and consumes a one-shot iterable (generator/iterator) returned by the hook, so the later alias comprehension sees nothing and the class silently ends up with no attributes.

judge.reason: Describes the one-shot iterable from field_transformer being consumed by the order check, leaving later steps with no attributes.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: Many existing assertions were flipped to expected-value-first form, which is out of scope for the #1147 fix, adds diff noise, and may violate the repo's style conventions; the reviewer would revert it.

judge.reason: Test style/diff noise complaint, not a defect.

findings.summary: The conflicting-defaults test hard-codes the full Attribute repr in the expected ValueError message, so it will break whenever Attribute gains or changes a field; asserting on a substring would be more robust.

judge.reason: Test brittleness is a style concern, not incorrect behavior in the change.
